page.overview:
Who is Cocytus?

Cocytus is one of the Divine Generals in Final Fantasy Dimensions. She is associated with the ice element.

Cocytus is a woman with pale skin and white hair with straight bangs styled into a updo style. She is dressed in a white dress with a black collar and walks barefoot.

Cocytus first appears in Jinnai's flashback, hidden behind a silhouette while discussing her plans with the Elder of the Fuga order.

Cocytus makes her first appearance to the Warriors of Darkness after they defeat the Elder and his Mind Parasite. She uses Blizzaga on the defeated Elder, encasing him within ice and effectively killing him. An enraged Jinnai lunges at her, but she freezes him with Blizzaga and encases him too in a block of ice. As she approaches the party a black void engulfs them and they vanish.
